manifesto.title: Expert in nothing.
manifesto.p1: Technology changes faster than anyone can master it.
manifesto.p2: So I don't pretend to know it all: I protect my curiosity and adapt.
manifesto.p3: Every project is an excuse to learn something new and build a better solution.

star.problem: A business doesn't know precisely how people move inside its store.
star.solution: A system that detects and tracks people by zone from one or several cameras using YOLOv8, and turns it into live KPIs, a heat map, dwell time per zone and exportable reports.
star.shotAlt: RetailVision Analytics monitoring dashboard with camera feed, real-time KPIs, zone distribution and heat map.
